frontier: Q14 proves that current P000/Q10 primitives plus H/R/D do not determine global effectivity at the C3/C2 quotient. Determine whether independently motivated composition, relabeling/rotation, and refinement-consistency laws constrain the quotient-selection freedom, or whether underdetermination survives those laws.
next_action: Build the smallest finite category/groupoid of one- and two-cycle C2 loop-state spaces generated by primitive-preserving relabelings and explicitly declared composition/refinement maps; enumerate effectivity selections satisfying each candidate consistency law separately and in combination, with matched countermodels for every claimed necessity.
research_value: Tests whether the Q14 effectivity independence persists under genuine cross-object structural laws or whether a noncircular composition/naturality principle reduces the semantic freedom; it distinguishes a real new axiom from merely renaming the target predicate.
